nodes.question: How can organizations overcome the lack of agility and insufficient encouragement to innovate in implementing digital technologies?
nodes.answer: Organizations can overcome this barrier by responding quickly to the changing needs of stakeholders, particularly customers, and making their supply chains more agile through the implementation of advanced technologies.
